_about: Production source policy (src/source_authority.policy_of). A domain or dataset is fetched only when listed here as `allowed` (or `identity_only`: fetched for identity keys, never a field value); its documents are evidence only when `allowed`. Everything else, an unlisted domain included, is `blocked`: search results on it are dropped before ranking and fetch, the fetch tools refuse it, and its cached documents (kept on disk) are not evidence. Domains match the host or any subdomain; the longest listed domain wins. The operator switches a domain between blocked and allowed on the Data page (an overlay in the data volume, every change logged); this file is the reviewed baseline. `terms_clause` is the clause the decision rests on; `terms_clause_source` says where it was taken from. `bulk_store`: the source may be stored as a local snapshot.
